info.title: SmartUni.Ai API
info.description: Production backend for the SmartUni.Ai Smart University Digital Campus platform. Provides REST APIs for attendance, fees, canteen, certificates, helpdesk, CampusAI tool-calling, ML early warning, and administrative analytics.

get.description: Return a single bus route by ID.

Server-Sent Events stream: pushes live telemetry every `interval` seconds.

Each event is a JSON object with all active bus routes. The stream runs until
the client disconnects or max_events is reached.
Pass max_events=1 and interval=0 for a quick test probe.
